## Figure 242. TIM16 block diagram

1. This signal can be used as trigger for some slave timer, see _Section 26.4.24: Using timer output as trigger for other timers_
   ### _(TIM16)_.
2. The internal break event source can be:
   ### - A clock failure event generated by CSS. For further information on the CSS, refer to _Section 5.2.10: Clock security system_
   ### _(CSS)_
   ### - A PVD output
   ### - SRAM parity error signal
   ### - Cortex®-M0+ LOCKUP (Hardfault) output
   ### - COMP output
